definitions.explanation: A vehicle designed for travel in outer space, either crewed or uncrewed. Used for both real spacecraft and fictional ones.

examples.japanese: {宇宙船|うちゅうせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{打|う}ち{上|あ}げられた→打ち上げる：06732_uchiageru⟧。
{宇宙船|うちゅうせん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{無事|ぶじ}→無事：01602_buji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{地球|ちきゅう}→地球：03461_chikyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{帰還|きかん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The spacecraft returned safely to Earth.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ころ→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧、いつか{宇宙船|うちゅうせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}りたい→乗る：00511_noru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}っていた→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: When I was a child, I dreamed of riding in a spaceship someday.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{宇宙|うちゅう}→宇宙：01861_uchuu⟧ (outer space) + ⟦{船|せん}→船：09875_sen⟧ (vessel). Covers both real spacecraft (like those used by NASA or JAXA) and fictional spaceships in science fiction.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {宇宙船|うちゅうせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}ち{上|あ}げる→打ち上げる：06732_uchiageru⟧: to launch a spacecraft
- {有人|ゆうじん}{宇宙船|うちゅうせん}: crewed spacecraft
- ⟦{無人|むじん}→無人：13388_mujin⟧{宇宙船|うちゅうせん}: uncrewed spacecraft
- {宇宙船|うちゅうせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{搭乗|とうじょう}→搭乗：06200_toujou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to board a spacecraft

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ロケット→ロケット：00353_roketto⟧: rocket — the launch vehicle, not the crewed capsule
- ⟦{人工衛星|じんこうえいせい}→人工衛星：11715_jinkoueisei⟧: artificial satellite — orbits but does not carry people
- ⟦{宇宙|うちゅう}→宇宙：01861_uchuu⟧⟦ステーション→ステーション：27940_suteeshon⟧: space station — a permanent structure in orbit
